title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 10: the sacrifices that could never take away sins, the one offering, and the call to hold fast and not shrink back.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say the law has?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says the law has a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things.

answers.text: A shadow of the good to come
The very image of the things
A new and living way
The pattern shown on the mountain

questions.text: What does verse 4 say is impossible?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

answers.text: That a priest should stand serving daily
That the law should ever be changed
That the blood of bulls and goats takes away sins
That worshipers be cleansed with pure water

questions.text: According to the words quoted in verse 5, what did God prepare for him?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 quotes: "You didn't desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me."

answers.text: A throne
A body
An altar
A scroll

questions.text: What did he say he had come to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 quotes: "Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God."

answers.text: To build a new temple
To offer whole burnt offerings
To gather the twelve tribes
To do the will of God

questions.text: What did he do after offering one sacrifice for sins forever?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says that when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, he sat down on the right hand of God.

answers.text: He sat down on the right hand of God
He returned to the earthly tabernacle
He offered the same sacrifice again
He stood serving day by day

questions.text: What is he waiting for from that time, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says he is waiting from that time until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

answers.text: Until the earthly temple is rebuilt
Until his enemies are made his footstool
Until the priests have been made perfect
Until the law is written once more

questions.text: By what do the readers have boldness to enter into the holy place?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says they have boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus.

answers.text: By the blood of goats
By the works of the law
By the blood of Jesus
By the hands of the priests

questions.text: What does the writer tell them not to forsake?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 tells them not to forsake their own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but to exhort one another.

answers.text: The reading of the law
The offerings for sin
The feast of the new moon
Their own assembling together

questions.text: What does verse 31 call a fearful thing?
questions.explanation: Verse 31 says it is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

answers.text: To fall into the hands of the living God
To be judged on the word of two witnesses
To lose all of your possessions
To be reproached and oppressed by men

questions.text: According to the words quoted in verse 38, how will the righteous live?
questions.explanation: Verse 38 quotes: "But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him."

answers.text: By the law
By faith
By works
By sacrifices
